kicker: Battery storage · when each part of the chain starts earning
title: Storage earns now; Indian LFP slips to FY28
dek: ACME's 5.2 GWh of batteries, all on Chinese cells, earned a 78% EBITDA margin in Q2. Gujarat Fluorochemicals pushed LFP revenue to end-FY28 or later; Himadri deferred 40,000 t of LFP.

chart.title: Months from now to each milestone
chart.sub: from November 2026 to the end of the period management gave on Q1–Q2 FY27 calls

stats.label: ACME's battery EBITDA margin
stats.note: 324 mn units sold at peak hours; FY27 target raised to over 12 GWh.

stats.label: Indian cells' cost premium
stats.note: Over landed Chinese cells: 5–10% at Exide, 10–15% at Amara Raja.

stats.label: Gujarat Fluoro's capex delay
stats.note: ₹2,100 cr FY27 battery capex spills into FY28; the anode project is paused.

read: Until a local-content rule arrives, storage growth buys Chinese cells; Q4 FY27 first supplies are the chain's next test.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and Q1–Q2 FY27 earnings calls; Vantage sector intel, 20 Nov 2026
notes: Each bar counts months from November 2026 to the end of the period stated on the latest call (Q4 FY27 = March 2027; Q2 2027 = June 2027; end-FY28 = March 2028; Amara Raja's 5 GWh LFP cell plant 'about 30 months' from its November approval). 'Pushed back' compares the Q2 call with the Q1 call: Gujarat Fluorochemicals expected LFP revenue toward end-FY27 and now says end-FY28 or start FY29; Himadri had 40,000 t of LFP due in FY28 and now says end-FY28. Exide's storage-cell line is ready but undated pending incentive clarity, so it is not charted; Neogen trimmed FY27 battery revenue to ₹250–300 cr from ≈₹300 cr.
